items.title: Meta May Have Found a Fix for Its 'Pervert Glasses'
items.summary: Meta is reportedly developing a version of its smart glasses without a camera, potentially addressing one of the biggest privacy objections to AI wearables.

items.title: CLARITY Act could get another shot during lame-duck session, policy advocate says
items.summary: Digital Sovereignty Alliance managing director Adrian Wall said senators from both parties are considering another attempt to advance the crypto market structure bill before the current Congress ends.

items.title: Bitcoin, ether swing after unanimous quarter-point Fed rate hike as Warsh takes aim at inflation
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether whipsawed as the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years.

items.title: The Next Bull Run Could Be One Big Airdrop Away
items.summary: History says major airdrops mark tops as often as they spark rallies, but the timing is everything.
